title: Oven Roasted Vietnamese Cabbage Bowl
description: A hearty solo dinner bowl with earthy roasted vegetables, crunchy raw cabbage, and a tangy tamari-lime sauce, all Jain-friendly and packed with fresh flavors.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Toss sliced cabbage, carrot, and bell pepper with 1 tbsp sesame oil, 1 tsp salt, and the tandoori spice mix until evenly coated.
Spread the seasoned vegetables in a single layer on the prepared baking sheet and roast for 18 minutes, stirring halfway, until edges are charred and vegetables are tender.
While the veggies roast, shred the remaining half of the cabbage into a bowl for the raw salad component.
In a small bowl, whisk together tamari sauce and lime juice from one wedge until lightly mixed.
Once roasted, remove the baking sheet from the oven and let the vegetables cool slightly.
Assemble the bowl by layering the roasted vegetables over the shredded raw cabbage, then drizzle the tamari-lime sauce over the top.
Sprinkle chopped cilantro over the entire bowl and optionally add extra lime wedges on the side for extra brightness.
